note: Straw is configured per term-reference field in two steps: field reference method = EntityReferenceSelection plugin 'straw' (Straw selection), and form widget = super_term_reference_autocomplete_widget (Autocomplete (Straw style)). It shows/searches the whole term hierarchy with '>>' as the level delimiter and can create a term plus missing parents via 'Parent >> Child'. No settings page, no permissions. Medium introspection reads back the widget of a Straw-configured field; hard execution switches a plain term-reference field to Straw (handler 'straw' + the Straw widget), verified on the live field config and form display. Fixtures create/delete their own field_straw_* field targeting the 'tags' vocabulary.

evals.prompt: How do you configure a taxonomy term-reference field to use the Straw (Super Term Reference Autocomplete Widget) module? Name both settings you must change.
evals.expected_output: Two steps: (1) set the field's reference method / selection handler to 'Straw selection' (plugin id straw) in the field settings; (2) set the widget on Manage form display to 'Autocomplete (Straw style)' (super_term_reference_autocomplete_widget).

evals.prompt: What does the '>>' delimiter mean in a Straw autocomplete field, both for display and for creating new terms?
evals.expected_output: '>>' separates levels of the term hierarchy. Existing values are shown with their full ancestry joined by '>>'. If term creation is enabled, typing e.g. 'Travel >> Tourist Destinations' creates each missing term in the path, parenting the child under the parent (reusing existing ancestors).

evals.prompt: What kind of field does Straw work on, and what module does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: It works on an entity-reference field that targets taxonomy terms (a term-reference field). It depends only on core Taxonomy.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a term-reference field (field_straw_known) configured to use the Straw module. Inspect the live default form display for Article and report the machine name of the widget that field uses.
evals.expected_output: field_straw_known uses the widget super_term_reference_autocomplete_widget (Autocomplete (Straw style)) in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default; its field handler is 'straw'.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a term-reference field field_straw_task that currently uses the default term autocomplete. Using the Straw module, switch this field to Straw: set its reference method to Straw selection and its form widget to 'Autocomplete (Straw style)'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.field.node.article.field_straw_task settings.handler === 'straw', and in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_straw_task component type === 'super_term_reference_autocomplete_widget'.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a term-reference field field_straw_known2 that has been set to use the Straw module's reference method. Inspect the live field configuration and report the machine name of the selection handler (reference method) it uses.

The Article field field_straw_fix already uses the 'Autocomplete (Straw style)' widget, but its reference method is still the default term handler, so Straw's hierarchy features don't work. Set its reference method to Straw selection so the field fully uses Straw. Apply the change to the live site.
